description: DRAFT - NOT AN ADOPTED CONTRACT: this form targets the native FHGM model contract v0.1, a proposal under FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification#204 (Option C hybrid: FHGFF3-embedded x-fhgm-models transport). FHGM has no schemaVersion, no versioned schema URL, no registry entry and no toolkit support; the opaque modelVersion in particular carries no ordering and its semantics are an open question that a later release may change. propertyDescriptions.modelId: Draft (#204: model identity and scope). Opaque model identifier, unique within one annotation snapshot and stable across a revision of the same model on the same assembly. Curator versus derived authority is an open question.
propertyDescriptions.modelVersion: Draft (#204: model identity and scope). Opaque model version. An immediate revision must use a value different from its predecessor; no ordering is implied.
propertyDescriptions.featureId: Draft (#204: model identity and scope). Exact decoded local GFF3 feature ID targeted by this record. The v0.1 default resolves one gene row; transcript scope is an open question. Resolution is a model-level check, not a schema constraint.
propertyDescriptions.reference: Draft (#204: reference coordinates). Reference assembly binding carried on the record so it stays interpretable when extracted from its file. Mirrors the FHGFF3 genome-link alternative: an FHR parent checksum, or an assembly accession with the supplied SeqCol digest; both forms may be supplied. Must not contradict the enclosing FHGFF3 header's genome link (model-level check). The draft contract requires at least one of genomeReference or annotates; the form leaves both optional, mirroring how the released FHGFF3 genome-link alternative is handled, and the draft schema plus the model-level checker decide.
propertyDescriptions.predecessor: Draft (#204: new and revised models). Immediate same-assembly predecessor: the prior annotation snapshot's file checksum with the prior record's model ID and version. Absent means no revision claim. A resolved pointer identifies a predecessor record; it never asserts curator acceptance.
propertyDescriptions.contributors: Draft (#204: credit and publication). Supplied model contributors and their roles. File metadata authors stay in the FHGFF3 metadataAuthor field; article authorship, journal review and curator acceptance stay outside this record.
propertyDescriptions.evidence: Draft (#204: evidence and methods). Supplied evidence statements for the model. These are producer assertions, distinct from validation results; the feature layer and external tools remain the place where evidence is checked.
propertyDescriptions.methods: Draft (#204: evidence and methods). Computational methods: software with versions, a protocol reference, and supplied limitations or uncertainty. The draft contract requires at least one methods member; leave the whole field unanswered rather than saving an empty object.
propertyDescriptions.publication: Draft (#204: credit and publication). Publication context of the model contribution. The article and the deposited model data keep separate, independently resolvable identities; the assembly identity stays in reference. The draft contract requires at least one of article or deposit; leave the whole field unanswered rather than saving an empty object.
propertyDescriptions.reuseConditions: Draft (#204: packaging and integrity). Reuse conditions supplied for this model record; not inferred from the article or file license.
